design.unit: (permno, month) cell with at least one news document
design.walk_forward: annual refit; train months <= (Y-1)-11, EMBARGO (Y-1)-12, test year Y
design.purge_rationale: the target at month m is the return over m+1, so one embargo month puts a clear month between the last training target window and the first test one
design.cv: walk-forward calendar folds only. NEVER random k-fold.
design.cost_note: turnover is measured name by name from the actual quintile membership, month over month; costs are never omitted
design.n_effective: TEST MONTHS (date blocks). Name-months are printed and labelled DO NOT USE.

screen_then_export.reading: SCREEN=BH-FDR admits a known false-discovery fraction and is for deciding what to look at next; EXPORT=Holm controls the family-wise error and is what a claim leaving this repository is judged by. `screened_not_exported` is the gap between 'worth another look' and 'defensible'.
